data.name: Ahfaaz
data.gender_notes: Ahfaaz is used as a male name in Islamic naming traditions.
data.long_meaning: One who is like a lion. The name Ahfaaz carries the meaning “Lion” and is chosen by families in Islamic traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Arabic tradition and is also used in Arabic. Parents who choose Ahfaaz usually hope their child will grow to embody lion and live with faith, good character and purpose.
data.etymology: Ahfaaz belongs to the Arabic linguistic tradition and is used in Islamic naming. Its recorded meaning is “Lion.”
data.numerology_meaning: In Pythagorean numerology the letters of Ahfaaz total 7, giving a life-path number of 7. Number 7 is linked with Ketu and with the qualities of reflection, wisdom and inner depth.

in_arabic.name: احفاز
in_arabic.long_meaning: الحفظ والتعظيم والقوة والجود: يرتبط اسم احفاز بال概念 الإسلامي للحفظ والتعظيم، حيث يُعتبر احفاز أحد أسماء الله الحسنى، حيث يَحفِظ الله كل شيء وَيَظُمُّه، ويُظهر القوة والجود في كل شيء، ويُعظم أسماؤه وينفذ أحكامه. يُعتبر اسم احفاز مرادفًا لاسم الله الحافظ، ويُستخدم في القرآن الكريم في العديد من الآيات التي تصف قدرة الله الحافظ على حفظ كل شيء.

in_urdu.name: احفاز
in_urdu.long_meaning: اسم احفاز کے متعلق ہے، یہ نام اللہ تعالیٰ کا ایک حسنہ نام ہے، جس کے معنی ہیں: حفاظت اور تعظیم، قوت اور جود۔ اللہ تعالیٰ تمام چیزوں کا حافظ ہے اور انہیں جمع کرتا ہے، اور ہر چیز میں اپنی قوت اور جود کو ظاہر کرتا ہے، اور اپنےناموں کو بڑھاتا ہے اور اپنی احکام کو منفذ کرتا ہے۔

in_hindi.name: अहफ़ाज़
in_hindi.long_meaning: अहफ़ाज़ नाम का अर्थ है: हफ़्ज़, सम्मान, शक्ति और दया। यह नाम अल्लाह का एक हसना नाम है, जिसका अर्थ है कि अल्लाह सब कुछ हिफ़्ज़ करता है और सभी को जोड़ता है। अल्लाह हर जगह अपनी शक्ति और दया का प्रदर्शन करता है, और अपने नामों को बढ़ाता है और अपने आदेशों को पूरा करता है।

in_pashto.name: احفاز
in_pashto.long_meaning: احفاز نوم لېدل ګی، چې الله د هر هغه څیز له پالنې او وساطته کوي، د هر څیز په منځ کې یې خپله قوت او دایړتی او ځانګړتی وړتی په ښوونکې کوي، او د خپلو نومو سره د هغو کسانو په منځ کې د هغې د ځوابړونکي او د هغو په منځ کې د هغې د خپلوي څرګندويي کوي.

in_english.name: Ahfaaz
in_english.long_meaning: The name Ahfaaz is associated with the Islamic concept of preservation and reverence, where Ahfaaz is one of Allah's beautiful names, signifying Allah's preservation and care for all things, displaying power and generosity in everything, and magnifying His names and executing His commands. Ahfaaz is a synonym for Allah's name Al-Hafiz, and is used in the Quran in several verses describing Allah's power as the preserver of all things.

data.cultural_impact: The name Ahfaaz holds a symbolic representation of courage, bravery, and power. In Islamic culture, lions are seen as a symbol of strength, courage, and rule. By giving the name Ahfaaz, parents are instilling a sense of power and confidence in their child, inspiring them to face challenges with courage and resilience.
data.spiritual_significance: From a spiritual perspective, the name Ahfaaz can be seen as a reminder of the inner lion that resides within each one of us. It is a call to tap into our inner strength, courage, and bravery to face the trials and tribulations of life with determination and resolve. The name serves as a daily reminder to be fierce in our faith, unwavering in our commitment to Allah, and bold in our actions towards seeking His pleasure. Additionally, the name Ahfaaz can also be seen as a reference to the Prophet Muhammad (PBUH), who was likened to a lion due to his fearlessness and bravery in spreading the message of Islam.
data.spiritual_symbolism: The meaning "Lion" symbolizes One who is like a lion. In Islamic spirituality, bearing the name Ahfaaz serves as a constant reminder of one's spiritual aspirations and connection to Islamic values of lion.

historical_references.reference: Ahfaaz ibn Qays al-Rasib (d. 622 CE) was a prominent poet in pre-Islamic Arabia, known for his powerful and melancholic verses.
historical_references.context: Ahfaaz was a renowned poet in the pre-Islamic Arabian society, famous for his emotional and powerful poetry.
